scope: Bounded coordinator reconciliation of recovered F082 particle-buffer coherence and selected writeback safeguards; not a whole-lens review.
observation: Particles exposes position, previous and velocity buffers while retaining private count, capacity and host inverse masses. A caller able to independently replace a buffer or upload different mass words can represent inconsistent host/device identities; the selected solver binds those public buffers and dispatches using the retained count. If a replacement position buffer yields a successful read with fewer decoded records than count, read_positions and read_inverse_masses take only the available records and return the shorter collection. Native admission, actual callers, buffer behavior and readback success are not established.
safeguards: Particles::write checks equal full position and mass slice lengths before packing and updates count and host masses after the shown uploads; its capacity comparison narrows length and has a separate representability question.

The selected OuterLayer and SurfaceContacts correction paths repack positions with the retained host inverse masses, and ParticlePositions::new rejects mismatched slice lengths before those uploads. They are not evidence of divergent mass writes under the displayed conditions.

write_positions restores the taken host mass cache on normal returned errors, and successful writes preserve the supplied host mass values. Native errors, panics and partial external device effects were not exercised.
